semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Yahata Neji provides specialized fasteners and components that are critical for semiconductor assembly and packaging processes.
summary: Yahata Neji manufactures high-performance fasteners and components, including advanced locking bolts and surface-treated fasteners, which are essential for maintaining the integrity and reliability of semiconductor assembly and packaging. Their innovative manufacturing techniques, such as NC lathe machining and cold heading, ensure high workability and effective torque application.
capabilities: Advanced locking bolts with wedge effect
